title: 1763. Longest Nice Substring

examples.explanation: "aAa" is a nice string because 'A/a' is the only letter of the alphabet in s, and both 'A' and 'a' appear. "aAa" is the longest nice substring.
"Bb" is a nice string because both 'B' and 'b' appear. The whole string is a substring.
